questions.question: Which method selects an element by its ID?

correct.title: Correct! 🎉
correct.details: document.getElementById('id-name') selects a single element by its ID attribute. IDs should be unique on a page.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔

questions.question: What property changes the text of an element?

correct.title: Correct! 🎉
correct.details: Both textContent (plain text) and innerHTML (HTML code) can change element content. Use textContent for security.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔

questions.question: How do you change an element's color with JavaScript?

correct.title: Correct! 🎉
correct.details: Use element.style.propertyName to change CSS styles. Note: property names use camelCase (backgroundColor, not background-color).

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
